Name: Cuter Shane (CP)
Author: Akayotic18
Description:
This mod features edited versions of both Shane's regular portrait as well as his beach portrait. Portrait edits include: more detailed hair, greener eyes, a cuter nose, and a slimmer jawline. Sprite edits include green eyes, less wild hair lol, and (in my opinion) a better JojaMart sprite! (:

In case you only want to use the portraits and not the sprites, just run the game once with this mod and it will generate a config file. Then go into the mod folder, click the config file, and change the word "True" to "False".

I hope you enjoy! <3
